scenarios.title: Interleaved legacy and target saves of one company row: last writer wins, every save audited as SYSADM

steps.sql: EXEC core.usp_UiMaintSave @MaintCode='CORE.COMPANY', @UserCode='SYSADM', @CompanyCode='STC', @Mode='CHANGE', @Data=N'<r><c n="CompanyCode" v="CAL" /><c n="Eori" v="GB000000000001" /></r>'
SELECT Eori, ModifiedBy FROM core.Company WHERE CompanyCode = 'CAL'
EXEC core.usp_UiMaintSave @MaintCode='CORE.COMPANY', @UserCode='SYSADM', @CompanyCode='STC', @Mode='CHANGE', @Data=N'<r><c n="CompanyCode" v="CAL" /><c n="Eori" v="GB000000000003" /></r>'

assertions.sql: SELECT Eori FROM core.Company WHERE CompanyCode = 'CAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.AuditLog WHERE EntityType = 'core.Company' AND EntityKey = 'CAL' AND Action = 'UPDATE' AND Source = 'TRIGGER' AND UserCode = 'SYSADM'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.AuditLog WHERE EntityType = 'CORE.COMPANY' AND EntityKey = 'CAL' AND Action = 'CHANGE' AND Source = 'STERP.exe' AND UserCode = 'SYSADM'

scenarios.derivation: Legacy oracle LO-COEX-01 (memory/STERP-App/agent-07/work/legacy-oracle-coexistence.out.txt): two legacy saves through core.usp_UiMaintSave on the isolated freshc deploy gave last-writer-wins Eori, ModifiedBy SYSADM and per save one core.Company UPDATE trigger row plus one CORE.COMPANY CHANGE STERP.exe row; the target save must reproduce the same procedure call (contracts 6.5, 6.8; platform_saveMaintenanceRow description; usp_UiMaintSave.sql:8-123).

scenarios.title: A save that carries only an unregistered column is refused with E-0095 and writes nothing

assertions.sql: SELECT TradingName FROM core.Company WHERE CompanyCode = 'CAL'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM core.AuditLog WHERE EntityKey = 'CAL' AND Action IN ('UPDATE', 'CHANGE')

scenarios.derivation: Legacy oracle LO-COEX-01: CHANGE with only TradingName (not a core.MaintColumn row of CORE.COMPANY) raised 50095 'STERP-E-0095: Nothing to save.' and left the row and core.AuditLog unchanged; contracts 4.6 maps THROW 5xxxx 'STERP-<s>-<code>' to 422 business-rule with reasonCode <s>-<code>.

scenarios.title: A run registered by the legacy batch path is listed by the target job monitor
scenarios.derivation: Legacy oracle LO-COEX-02: core.usp_JobRunStart (jobs\SETENV.cmd:99) registered NIGHTLY/STC/OPS as RUNNING with no return code and core.usp_UiJobList returned it; jobs_listRuns executes core.usp_UiJobList and lists runs of legacy and target writers alike (contracts 6.10).
